research_integrity: Exact rational finite-state derivation with two independently organized forward/backward arithmetic certificates; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One finite graph, not a thermodynamic-limit result
No desorption, diffusion or heterogeneous individual-edge rates
No proof that the positive-rate minimizing rate is unique
Historical priority and independent scientific audit remain open
scientific_scope: Irreversible exponential-clock edge-dimer adsorption on the sixteen-vertex four-cube, with one coordinate direction having adjustable nonnegative rate and three others rate one.
title: Singular weak-channel rescue and reentrant dimer jamming on the four-cube
